They are also a Core Team Member at Google Developer Groups (GDG), where they tracked registration data and increased participant engagement [Source 2].

The individual has worked on various projects, including Crop Disease Classification, AI-Based Peer Behavior Similarity Detector, and Collaborative Class – Academic Collaboration Platform [Source 3]. They are proficient in multiple programming languages, including Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java, and have experience with web technologies, backend & APIs, databases, machine learning, and data science & analytics [Source 4]. They also hold certifications such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Certified Data Science Professional, Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer, and MongoDB Certified Associate Developer (Node.js) [Source 5].
